notes_for_editor: Hold this story unpublished: it has no history, only a record. The name 'Jarvis Lake Tower', its class 'Fire Tower' and its point coordinates come from the cached LIO tower layer (data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson), but the geoHub dataset page cached for the cited URL is a JavaScript shell that shows only the title 'Tower', so the name cannot be quoted from a readable page and the cited quote does not verify the name. The layer lists no build date, height, builder or status in its fields that were populated. Two searches found no fire tower history for a Jarvis Lake in Ontario; a web search suggested that several Ontario lakes share the name, but that was not checked, and the district was not determined. The brief's location is marked approximate. The story is well under the 120-word minimum and should be enlarged only if a readable source turns up (for example a Clayton Self or Forest History Society of Ontario page, or a district record).
